The gradle-wrapper.jar binary must be generated locally.

Run ONE of these commands to generate it:

Option A — if you have Gradle installed locally:
    gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.6

Option B — via Docker (bootstrap container):
    docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/workspace -w /workspace \
        gradle:8.6-jdk17 gradle wrapper

After running either command, the file gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar
will appear and the build will work normally.
